themes.label: IRON ORE, COPPER & DIVERSIFIED MINERS
themes.note: The producers' exchange. BHP, Rio Tinto, Fortescue and South32 are the iron-ore and copper complex in one place; Mineral Resources, Pilbara Minerals, IGO and Liontown cover lithium and the battery chain. These are the equity side of the industrial-metals segment in the COMMODITIES tab.

themes.label: GOLD
themes.note: Australian gold miners: the ASX is one of the few exchanges where the gold price is a pure operating lever rather than a small part of a diversified book. Watch the AUD gold price, not just the USD one — a weaker Australian dollar lifts these margins.

themes.label: ENERGY & LNG
themes.note: Woodside and Santos are the LNG exporters; Karoon and Origin carry the domestic gas and transition story. Revenue is contracted in USD and priced off oil and Asian LNG, so the AUD/USD rate moves the earnings as much as the commodity does.

themes.label: BANKS & FINANCIALS
themes.note: The four pillars plus Macquarie and Suncorp. Australian banks are a leveraged bet on the housing cycle and the cash rate; the net interest margin is the line that moves when the RBA does.

themes.label: HEALTHCARE
themes.note: CSL is the blood-plasma franchise and the market's largest non-bank; ResMed sells sleep apnoea devices in USD; Cochlear and Sonic round out the defensive growth block. Earnings are largely USD and EUR, so this is an offshore-earnings hedge in an AUD portfolio.

themes.label: CONSUMER
themes.note: Woolworths, Coles and Wesfarmers are the domestic spending read; JB Hi-Fi is the discretionary electronics chain; Super Retail adds auto, outdoor and sporting goods; Aristocrat is the global gaming-content exporter. Margins track wage costs, electricity and the consumer’s savings buffer.

themes.label: INDUSTRIALS & TRANSPORT
themes.note: Telstra and TPG are the telecom infrastructure; Amcor is global packaging; Qantas is the travel cycle; Brambles is pallets and supply chains. A mixed group, but the domestic-demand leg of the market.

themes.label: REAL ESTATE
themes.note: Goodman, Scentre, GPT and Vicinity are the listed property trusts. They are a bond proxy: the cap rate moves inversely with the 10-year yield, and gearing makes the move bigger than the asset value suggests.

themes.label: TECHNOLOGY
themes.note: Xero and WiseTech are the global software exporters; REA is the property-portal monopoly; Computershare is registry and share services; NEXTDC runs the data centres; Megaport sells cloud connectivity. Small by index weight, but the ASX’s growth end.
